role.description: The scene's function in the explainer arc (historical or conceptual).

narration.description: The voiceover for this scene — one or two crisp documentary sentences, sized to the scene's seconds (~2.6 words/sec).

visual_brief.description: What the cinematic still depicts (subject, setting, era, mood) — no on-screen text.

keywords.description: On-screen keyword pop-ups for this scene (1-4 short terms).

timeline.description: Optional event timeline for this scene (e.g. the key-events scene): a list of year/markers, e.g. [1789, 1791, 1793].

card.description: Optional revision card for this scene (e.g. the final revision scene): a title + bullet points.
